summary: India successfully launched its Chandrayaan-3 mission in 2023, with the launch occurring on July 14, 2023.

claim_analysis.explanation: Chandrayaan-3 was a Moon lander and rover mission by India's space agency, ISRO.
Chandrayaan-3 was launched on July 14, 2023. It subsequently touched down in the Moon's south polar region on August 23, 2023.

evidence: Chandrayaan-3 was a Moon lander and rover mission by India's space agency. The spacecraft launched on July 14, 2023 and touched down in the Moon's south polar region on August 23, 2023.
Chandrayaan-3 was launched on 14 July 2023, at 14:35 IST from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC) in Sriharikota, India.
Chandrayaan-3 was launched on 14 July 2023 aboard LVM3 and on 16 August 2023, the composite attained a final lunar orbit of 113 km × 157 km (70 mi × 98 mi).
Chandrayaan-3 was the third lunar mission of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), launching on the 14th July 2023 and landing on the Moon on 23rd August 2023.
Chandrayaan-3 was Launched on 14, July 2023 at 14:35Hrs. IST, from the Second launch pad SDSC-SHAR, Sriharikota by The Indian Space Research Organisation's (ISRO).

Chandrayaan-3 is India's next moon mission. The spacecraft launched to the moon on July 14, 2023, at 5:05 a.m. EDT (0905 GMT or 2:35 p.m. local time July 14) from the Satish Dhawan Space Center in Sriharikota, India atop the medium-lift Launch Vehicle Mark-III (LVM3) rocket.

Chandrayaan-3 launched from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota Range (SDSC SHAR), India, on 14 July 2023 on a mission to demonstrate new technologies and to achieve India's first soft landing on another celestial body.
The launch is scheduled for July 14, 2023, at 14:35 Hrs. IST from the Second Launch Pad, SDSC-SHAR, Sriharikota.
